'''Bureau Chief''' was the title given to the head [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] working at a [[NewsNet]] [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] office. [[Robbe Nostler]] was the Bureau Chief of the [[Galactic News Network]]'s [[Indu San/Legends|Indu San]] [[Indu GNN bureau|office]].
